description: This file defines the TemplateHandler class, responsible for managing Smarty templates within the SuiteCRM project. It includes methods for building, checking, displaying, and deleting templates, as well as generating quick search code snippets. The class extensively interacts with file system operations, global configurations, and other SuiteCRM components like BeanFactory and QuickSearchDefaults.

classes.name: TemplateHandler
classes.description: A PHP class managing Smarty template files within SuiteCRM, including building, checking, displaying, deleting templates, and generating quicksearch code snippets.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the TemplateHandler instance, setting the cache directory.

methods.name: loadSmarty
methods.description: Loads the Smarty templating engine instance if not already initialized.

methods.name: clearAll
methods.description: Clears cache of all template files for all modules.

methods.name: clearCache
methods.description: Clears cached template files for a specific module and view, including theme-based templates.

methods.name: buildTemplate
methods.description: Constructs a Smarty template file for a given module and view, incorporating metadata and JavaScript validations.

methods.name: checkTemplate
methods.description: Checks if a template file exists for a given module, view, and optional form name.

methods.name: displayTemplate
methods.description: Fetches and returns the rendered template content, building it if necessary.

methods.name: deleteTemplate
methods.description: Deletes an existing template file for a specified module and view.

methods.name: createQuickSearchCode
methods.description: Generates JavaScript code for quicksearch functionality for given form and metadata definitions.

methods.name: getQSDLookup
methods.description: Provides lookup array for QuickSearchDefaults; designed to be overridden if needed.
